NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Ads Free Rewards
patches.description: Skip rewarded ads and claim rewards instantly

options.title: Patch version
options.description: Which implementation of the patch to use

options.title: Reward Strategy
options.description: Which ad-network integration to patch. 'Auto' covers every supported network

options.title: Instant reward
options.description: Claim the reward immediately without showing an ad (applies to the current patch version)

patches.name: No Ads
patches.description: Remove ads

options.title: Block Interstitials
options.description: Block full-screen ads shown between app content

options.title: Block Banners
options.description: Block banner ads shown at the top or bottom of the screen

options.title: Block App Open
options.description: Block ads shown when the app starts

options.title: Block MREC
options.description: Block medium rectangle (MREC) banner ads

options.title: Block Rewarded
options.description: Block rewarded ads; may disable features that require watching them

patches.name: Skip Consent Popup
patches.description: Skip the Google consent (GDPR) popup

patches.name: Skip Rate-Us Prompt
patches.description: Skip the in-app review (rate us) prompt

patches.name: Spoof Play Store Install Source
patches.description: Make the app believe it was installed from the Play Store

patches.name: Limit Ad Tracking
patches.description: Neutralize the Google advertising ID: empty ID and limit ad tracking enabled

patches.name: Remove Permissions
patches.description: Remove permissions from the app manifest

options.title: Permissions to remove
options.description: Comma-separated permission names to remove from the manifest

patches.name: Remove Hardware Requirements
patches.description: Remove uses-feature entries so the app installs on more devices

options.title: Features to remove
options.description: Comma-separated feature names to remove; leave empty to remove all uses-feature entries

patches.name: Unlock Rotation
patches.description: Remove screenOrientation locks so the app rotates freely

patches.name: Force Landscape / Portrait
patches.description: Force the app to a fixed screen orientation

options.title: Orientation
options.description: Force a fixed screen orientation on all activities

patches.name: Make App Debuggable
patches.description: Sets android:debuggable so debuggers and profiling tools can attach

patches.name: Change Version Code
patches.description: Overrides the android:versionCode declared in the manifest

options.title: Version code
options.description: New version code. Use -1 (default) to keep the original.

patches.name: Change Version Name
patches.description: Overrides the android:versionName declared in the manifest

options.title: Version name
options.description: New version name (e.g. 2.5.1). Leave empty to keep the original.

patches.name: Rename App
patches.description: Overrides the launcher label of the app

options.title: App name
options.description: New launcher name. Leave empty to keep the original.

patches.name: Remove App Icon
patches.description: Replaces the launcher icon with a transparent drawable

patches.name: Allow Cleartext Traffic
patches.description: Sets android:usesCleartextTraffic and drops any network security config so plain HTTP requests are allowed (useful for debugging through local proxies)

patches.name: Keep Screen On
patches.description: Adds android:keepScreenOn to every theme so the display stays on while any activity of the app is visible

patches.name: Remove Backup Restrictions
patches.description: Sets android:allowBackup and removes data extraction / full backup rules that exclude app data from device transfers and cloud backups

patches.name: Export All Activities
patches.description: Marks every activity as android:exported so other apps and ADB can launch them

patches.name: Disable Battery Optimization Prompt
patches.description: Removes the permission and intent filters apps use to ask for battery optimization exemptions, so the 'Ignore battery optimizations?' dialog never appears

patches.name: Remove Network Security Config
patches.description: Removes the app's network security config so certificate pinning and cleartext restrictions fall back to platform defaults (useful for HTTPS inspection)

patches.name: Enable Large Heap
patches.description: Sets android:largeHeap so the app gets a bigger Java heap on devices that allow it, reducing OutOfMemoryError crashes in memory-hungry games

patches.name: Force Hardware Acceleration
patches.description: Sets android:hardwareAccelerated so every activity renders with GPU acceleration, even when the app disables it globally

patches.name: Legacy External Storage
patches.description: Sets android:requestLegacyExternalStorage so the app keeps using the classic shared-storage model instead of scoped storage (Android 10; ignored on 11+)

patches.name: Keep Data on Uninstall
patches.description: Sets android:hasFragileUserData so Android offers to keep the app's data when uninstalling (the confirmation dialog appears on Android 10+)

patches.name: Set Install Location
patches.description: Overrides the android:installLocation declared in the manifest

options.title: Install location
options.description: Where Android prefers to install the app.

patches.name: Force Resizable Activity
patches.description: Sets android:resizeableActivity and drops the required touchscreen feature so the app can run in split-screen, free-form windows, DeX, and Chromebooks

patches.name: Immersive Fullscreen
patches.description: Adds android:windowFullscreen to every theme so activities render edge-to-edge without the status bar

patches.name: Strip Translations
patches.description: Deletes all translated resources so only the default language remains, reducing APK size. Android falls back to the default strings automatically.

patches.name: Disable Vibration
patches.description: Replaces framework Vibrator.vibrate calls with no-ops so apps cannot make the device buzz

patches.name: Disable Crash Reporters
patches.description: No-ops the static init/start/register methods of bundled crash-reporting SDKs (Crashlytics, Fabric, Sentry, Bugsnag, ACRA, HockeyApp, AppCenter, Instabug, Countly)

patches.name: Disable App Links Verification
patches.description: Removes android:autoVerify from intent filters so Android stops prompting to verify the app's web domains and never converts links into app opens

patches.name: Support All Screens
patches.description: Removes compatible-screens restrictions and marks every screen size supported so the app installs on devices it would otherwise reject

patches.name: Remove Ad Services Entries
patches.description: Strips Privacy Sandbox (AdServices) permissions, the ad ID permission and their config metadata from the manifest

patches.name: Disable Permission Auto-Revoke
patches.description: Sets android:autoRevokePermissions to discouraged so Android stops resetting unused permissions of apps you rarely open

patches.name: Ensure Internet Permission
patches.description: Adds the INTERNET permission if it is missing. Useful after aggressive permission stripping or for offline builds that still need web endpoints

patches.name: Status Bar Icons
patches.description: Forces the status bar and navigation bar icon color in every theme. Pick white icons for dark backgrounds or dark icons for light backgrounds

options.title: Icon color
options.description: Color of the system bar icons while the app is open.

patches.name: Fake Online State
patches.description: Makes connectivity checks report an active connection: WifiManager.isWifiEnabled, NetworkInfo.isConnected/isAvailable/isConnectedOrConnecting all return true

patches.name: Set Profileable
patches.description: Adds <profileable android:shell="true"/> so profilers (Android Studio, simpleperf, Perfetto) can attach to release builds for performance analysis

patches.name: Force Extract Native Libs
patches.description: Sets android:extractNativeLibs so native libraries are extracted at install time. Some mod loaders, hooks and older tools only work with extracted libs

patches.name: Unlock Max Aspect Ratio
patches.description: Removes maxAspectRatio limits from the application, activities and metadata so the app fills tall edge-to-edge screens instead of letterboxing

patches.name: Bypass VPN Detection
patches.description: Makes NetworkCapabilities report no VPN: hasTransport always returns false and hasCapability always returns true, so apps cannot block or alter behavior on VPN

patches.name: Spoof Device Model
patches.description: Replaces common android.os.Build fields (model, manufacturer, brand) with custom values. Leave an option empty to keep the original value

options.title: Model
options.description: Build.MODEL, e.g. Pixel 10 Pro XL. Empty keeps the original.

options.title: Manufacturer
options.description: Build.MANUFACTURER, e.g. Google. Empty keeps the original.

options.title: Brand
options.description: Build.BRAND, e.g. google. Empty keeps the original.

patches.name: Bypass OkHttp Pinning
patches.description: No-ops the certificate verification entry points of bundled OkHttp clients so certificate pinning never rejects connections

patches.name: Trust User Certificates
patches.description: No-ops the check methods of app-bundled X509TrustManager implementations so custom certificate validation (including pinning reimplemented by hand) accepts anything

patches.name: Spoof Build Fingerprint
patches.description: Replaces every read of Build.FINGERPRINT with a custom value, useful for integrity and device checks. Leave empty to keep the original fingerprint

options.title: Fingerprint
options.description: A full Android build fingerprint, e.g. google/mustang/mustang:17/CP2A.260605.012/15430684:user/release-keys

patches.name: Optimize as Game
patches.description: Sets android:appCategory to game so Android applies game mode, battery and screenshot optimizations tuned for games

patches.name: Relax Shared Libraries
patches.description: Marks every <uses-library> entry as optional so missing shared libraries no longer block the app from installing on devices that lack them

patches.name: Transparent System Bars
patches.description: Forces the status bar and navigation bar to render transparent in every theme so app content draws edge-to-edge behind them

patches.name: Custom Startup Toast
patches.description: Shows a customizable toast message every time the app starts

options.title: Toast message
options.description: Text shown in the toast on every app start.

options.title: Duration
options.description: How long the toast stays visible.

patches.name: Custom Startup Dialog
patches.description: Shows a customizable dialog once when the app is opened

options.title: Dialog title
options.description: Title of the startup dialog.

options.title: Dialog message
options.description: Body text of the startup dialog.
options.default: This app has been modified by Nai's Patches.

options.title: Dismissable
options.description: Allow closing the dialog with the back button or outside taps.

patches.name: Enable WebView Debugging
patches.description: Turns on WebView remote debugging: existing setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled calls are forced to true and it is actively enabled at startup, so WebViews can be inspected via chrome://inspect

patches.name: Fake Battery Whitelist
patches.description: Makes PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations always return true so apps stop nagging about battery optimization exemptions

patches.name: Spoof Signature Match
patches.description: Makes PackageManager.checkSignatures always return SIGNATURE_MATCH so apps that verify their own or another package's signature accept any build

patches.name: Spoof Play Integrity
patches.description: Force Play Integrity checks to pass

patches.name: Bypass License Verification
patches.description: Always pass Google Play license checks

patches.name: Bypass Google Play Services Check
patches.description: Always report Google Play Services as available

patches.name: Pairip Bypass (Experimental)
patches.description: Bypass Pairip license protection

patches.name: Unlock RevenueCat Entitlements
patches.description: Unlock all RevenueCat entitlements

patches.name: Unlock All IAPs (Unity IAP)
patches.description: Unlock all in-app purchases in Unity IAP games (Experimental)

patches.name: Custom App Resolution (Experimental)
patches.description: Set a custom resolution for the game

options.title: Enable Custom Resolution
options.description: Override the game's window size with the width and height below

options.title: Resolution width (px)
options.description: Horizontal resolution in pixels

options.title: Resolution height (px)
options.description: Vertical resolution in pixels

patches.name: Allow Screenshots
patches.description: Remove the screenshot-blocking window flag

patches.name: Skip Splash Screen (Experimental)
patches.description: Skip or shorten splash screen delays

patches.name: Disable Root Checks
patches.description: Disable root detection

patches.name: Disable Update Checks
patches.description: Disable in-app update prompts

patches.name: Disable Telemetry
patches.description: Block analytics and tracking

options.description: Mobile attribution analytics
